verdict.rationale: Restate's natural-language support is indirect. Its docs, templates and a plugin integrate with coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to help build Restate apps, a probe found an official MCP server documented on the AI-assistant page, and llms.txt is published. None of this shows users managing services, deployments or invocations through natural-language commands; that operational control is documented only via the CLI and admin/SQL APIs. Missing for 10: documented natural-language operation of the server (deployments, invocations, state), and clarity on whether the MCP server exposes operational tools rather than just docs.
